_comment: Copy to <project>/.claude/habits.json and edit. All patterns are case-insensitive regexes searched in paths (forward slashes), commands, URLs or queries. docs: files or folders, relative to the project or absolute; a reminder fires at session end if a trigger happened and none of its docs changed afterwards. This example is the Rivals 2 Falcon port's setup. tokens (optional, these are the defaults): context warning past context_warn then every context_step tokens; big_output = tool output size (tokens) that gets a nudge.

block.message: Git Bash rewrites /Game/... arguments: prefix the command with MSYS_NO_PATHCONV=1.

reminders.name: changelog
reminders.message: This session changed the mod but docs/CHANGELOG.md has no newer edit. Add a player-facing line under Unreleased (and a REVIEW_QUEUE.md entry for anything the user must check), or say why not.

reminders.name: knowledge
reminders.message: This session did research but docs/knowledge/ has no newer edit. Record what was learned (Status + Evidence; tested / researched / guess), or say why nothing new was learned.
